text:
DroidDeck brings the SteamOS experience to Android: Steam Gaming Mode, full Linux desktop, integration with GOG, Epic Games, Xbox, and other storefronts, Steam VR, and more!

 100% open source. No ads. No telemetry. No proprietary components. No source withheld. 

 
 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 
 

 

 The official website is droid-deck.dev. Only download DroidDeck from this repository's Releases.

 
 
 
 
 
 

 Install

1. Android 9 or newer on Adreno 730 or newer, or any 8xx. Adreno 6xx, Mali, Xclipse and PowerVR are experimental. Adreno 710 is currently unsupported. No root needed.
2. About 3 GB free for the runtime, plus 1.1 GB for the desktop and emulators.
3. Install the APK, install the Linux runtime, press Play and sign in to Steam.
4. On Android 14 and newer, turn on Disable child process restrictions in Developer options. On Android 12 and 13, Steam's first launch shows a Fix it for me button that walks you through it.

Smart glasses setup is in the support matrix. Release notes are in docs/releases.

Help, Preview builds and device reports are on Discord. For bugs, post in bug-reports with the zip from Share logs .

 Build

Needs Docker, Java 17, the Android SDK and NDK, Rust via rustup, Go, a host C compiler, the x86 64 and i686 MinGW-w64 compilers (i686 with DWARF-2 exceptions, as Debian and Ubuntu ship it; SJLJ builds such as Homebrew's cannot link Rust's i686-pc-windows-gnu ), GitHub CLI, Python 3 and zstd . On x86 64 Linux, Docker also needs an arm64 binfmt handler ( docker run --privileged --rm tonistiigi/binfmt --install arm64 ).

 

The APK lands in app/build/outputs/apk/release/ . Install it with tools/deploy local.sh . After the first run, ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease reuses the prepared inputs. Unit tests run with ./gradlew -PskipRust=true :app:testDebugUnitTest , and the helper and preload suite with bash tools/test local.sh .

On Windows, see tools/run windows.ps1 and tools/prepare windows runtime.py .

 Limits

Compatibility and performance vary by device. Desktop compositing is software rendered, and Firefox sandboxing is reduced under proot.

 Credits and licence

DroidDeck is GPL-3.0. Steam and Proton belong to Valve Corporation. VITURE, RayNeo, XREAL, Rokid, REDMAGIC, Nintendo Switch and Joy-Con are trademarks of their owners. This project is not affiliated with any of them.

 
 Runtime, Wine and Proton 

- Runtime, shim, input and controller work build on WinNative and Bannerlator by maxjivi05.
- mmap ring buffer controller input by ribbit384 (WinNative 345).
- FEX (MIT) runs x86 code. DroidDeck's build puts the platform name under AT PLATFORM so sharun AppImages by VHSgunzo (MIT) start through its userland-execve loader (MIT), and its GL thunk hands X errors to the program's own error handler. FEX's code disk cache was checked in its source.
- x86 AppImages, and arm64 ones whose runtime can't unpack on Android, are unpacked with uruntime by VHSgunzo (MIT), shipped unmodified with its licence.
- x86 programs linking OpenSSL 3 use the copy in the Steam Linux Runtime 4.0. x86 Linux games get the /etc/asound.conf that pressure-vessel writes.
- WriteProcessMemory hooks fall back to /proc/ /mem the way Wine's server/ptrace.c did before Wine 11.
- Windows programs on noexec storage get executable copies of their image pages, following @yujikaido's finding in droiddeck-rp4pro that Wine's own processes need the noexec shim.
- Wine write watches use userfaultfd support in Proton's dlls/ntdll/unix/virtual.c (LGPL-2.1-or-later). libddsession supplies the arm64 syscall number and answers PAGEMAP SCAN from /proc/self/pagemap .
- libddsession runs Wine's arm64 SIGUSR2 context handler ( dlls/ntdll/unix/signal arm64.c , LGPL-2.1-or-later) in place on a frame laid out like Linux's arch/arm64/kernel/signal.c , and serves fill vm counters in dlls/ntdll/unix/process.c the kernel's own /proc/ /status .
- droiddeck-ntsync follows the Linux ntsync semantics in Documentation/userspace-api/ntsync.rst (GPL-2.0).
- The proot fast path orders bindings like PRoot's path/binding.c (GPL-2.0-or-later).
- DiRT 3 and DiRT Showdown keep their telemetry socket the way RoccoC's DiRTTelemetryErrorFix (MIT) does, based on the fix by Carsten Gottschling.
- Zink on PowerVR keeps colour textures in colour with Icenowy Zheng's upstream Mesa fix d55418dae7 (MIT), carried as a runtime patch.
- Games and AppImage, Flatpak and Snap programs such as emulators use TU DEBUG=sysmem by default, as does the Steam client. Turnip sysmem rendering can be turned off in Performance settings, except with the Adreno 710/720 driver, which always uses it.
- Black Ops III and Dark Souls Remastered start without umu-protonfixes (BSD-2-Clause), whose 311210.py and 570940.py fail under ARM64 Proton.
- ReSkate (GPL-3.0) by Dingo Shenanigans uses the launch option from its README and D3D12 feature level 12 1.
- The arm64 client's sign in was checked by reading Steam's saved token with the ConnectCache format from deadlock-api-ingest.

 

 
 Stores 

- Epic Games and GOG build on Phobos's adaptation of Legendary and gogdl. GOG install script registry entries are read the way Heroic Games Launcher (GPL-3.0) reads them. GOG cloud storage requests send the Galaxy communication-service User-Agent that gogdl and Lutris (GPL-3.0) send.
- Epic's official Linux launcher preview runs through FEX. That setup is outside Epic's listed Linux support.
- The launcher's .deb gets the WebKitGTK and GTK 3 libraries it needs from unmodified Debian 13 packages, following @zooluis's research in 2268.
- Battle.net is by @kayakyakr. It runs Blizzard's own client in Proton (downloaded from Blizzard, not included) and shows key art from the Battle.net Shop. Without Steam, its games see the pad as an Xbox 360 controller via PROTON SPOOF STEAMINPUT VIDPID in Proton's dlls/winebus.sys .
- The EA store follows the EA app's protocols as documented by ArmchairDevelopers' Maxima (GPL-3.0): sign-in, the GraphQL queries (included verbatim, since EA matches them by ha
